added.title: Public Works Deputy Director/City Engineer
added.description:
Come join the City of Appleton! Here at the City, you’ll have the opportunity to grow and enjoy your best life through challenging work, great teams, training opportunities, and making a lasting impact on the community. We welcome and respect all employees as they are. Come join our team—you belong here!
The City is accepting applications for a full-time Deputy Director/City Engineer.
This is a management, professional, and administrative position responsible for providing strategic leadership and operational oversight of the Engineering, Traffic, and Parking functions of the Department of Public Works. This position provides direction and support to division managers, leads departmental planning and capital improvement initiatives, oversees operating and capital budgets, and provides professional engineering and operational guidance to ensure effective delivery of public infrastructure, transportation, parking, and related services. The position also works closely with City leadership, elected officials, other City departments, regulatory agencies, consultants, contractors, developers, and community stakeholders on capital projects, policies, development proposals, and service improvements. The incumbent works under the general direction of the Director of Public Works.

Qualifications

This position requires a bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a related field, Wisconsin Professional Engineer (P.E.) registration, and a minimum of eight years of progressively responsible professional experience in civil or municipal engineering, public works, project management, or a related field, including significant supervisory, administrative, or leadership experience, or an equivalent combination of education, experience, and training.

The ideal candidate will have strong knowledge of municipal engineering, public infrastructure, transportation, and public rights-of-way, and the ability to lead professional and technical staff, develop strategic and capital improvement plans, manage budgets, oversee complex projects, evaluate engineering plans and proposals, and build effective partnerships with City officials, employees, contractors, developers, regulatory agencies, and the public. The successful candidate will demonstrate sound judgment, strategic thinking, strong communication skills, and the ability to balance technical, operational, financial, regulatory, and community considerations. The ability to maintain a valid driver’s license and good driving record is required.

Salary

The salary range for this position is $93,662 - $140,483 annually plus an excellent fringe benefit package including: paid time off; health, dental and vision insurance; free employee health clinic and coach; life insurance; short-/long-term disability insurance; accident insurance; on-site fitness center; health and wellness programs; post-employment health plan; deferred compensation; and Wisconsin Retirement System (WRS). We are proud to share the WRS is among the best funded and best managed public pension systems in the country!

Anticipate and address unmet customer needs through insight-driven solutions.
Build, protect, and actively manage a robust intellectual property portfolio.

Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

Sr. Engineering Manager

Operational Engineering & Software Reliability

Technology Enablement is building shared engineering capabilities that improve software reliability, security, operational excellence, engineering productivity, and product delivery outcomes across a diverse portfolio of products and platforms.

We are seeking a Senior Engineering Manager to build and lead a team responsible for improving software reliability, vulnerability remediation, operational readiness, and engineering effectiveness. This leader will partner closely with Product Engineering, Platform Engineering, Cybersecurity, and Operations teams to establish scalable processes, reduce engineering friction, improve software quality, and create repeatable capabilities that can be leveraged across the enterprise.

The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering leadership with experience driving cross-functional transformation initiatives. They are proficient in modern software development practices, can build organizational capabilities from the ground up, and are passionate about improving the systems, tools, and operating models that support software delivery at scale.

This role is responsible for establishing a centralized engineering capability focused on vulnerability remediation, software health, dependency management, and engineering sustainability. The successful candidate will help advance automation, AI-assisted engineering practices, and developer productivity solutions while ensuring quality, reliability, and accountability remain core operating principles.

What You'll Do

Build and Lead a High-Performing Engineering Team

Recruit, coach, and develop software engineers responsible for software reliability, vulnerability remediation, software quality, and operational engineering initiatives.
Establish a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence.
Create clear goals, performance expectations, career development plans, and operating principles for the team.
Foster an enablement mindset focused on helping engineering teams deliver secure, reliable, and maintainable software.
Build organizational capabilities that can scale across multiple applications, products, and business domains.

Establish a Scalable Vulnerability Remediation Capability

Partner with Cybersecurity teams to translate vulnerability findings and risk insights into actionable engineering work.
Develop repeatable processes for intake, prioritization, remediation, validation, escalation, and reporting.
Create visibility into remediation progress, software health trends, dependency risks, and recurring issues.
Standardize how engineering teams respond to security and software health challenges across the portfolio.
Drive consistency in ownership, accountability, and execution of remediation activities.
Scale successful practices and capabilities across additional products and engineering organizations over time.

Improve Software Reliability and Quality

Lead initiatives that improve reliability, maintainability, operational readiness, software quality, and long-term engineering sustainability.
Partner with Product Engineering leaders to reduce recurring operational interruptions, technical debt, and engineering toil.
Support efforts related to dependency management, security remediation, modernization, software health, validation, and observability.
Identify common engineering challenges and develop reusable solutions, standards, automation, and tooling.
Establish scalable practices that improve software delivery outcomes while maintaining appropriate controls and quality standards.

Build Operational Excellence Capabilities

Collaborate with leaders across Technology Enablement, Product Engineering, Platform Engineering, Cybersecurity, and Operations.
Evaluate existing software delivery and operational processes to identify inefficiencies and improvement opportunities.
Develop operating models that improve consistency, efficiency, transparency, and quality outcomes.
Advance reliability engineering, software health management, and operational support capabilities.
Promote effective engineering practices that enable teams to deliver faster while maintaining security and reliability standards.

Drive Cross-Functional Discovery and Transformation

Lead exploratory efforts to understand challenges affecting engineering productivity, software quality, and operational performance.
Work with stakeholders to identify root causes, recurring patterns, organizational constraints, and process gaps.
Translate findings into prioritized initiatives, roadmaps, and measurable improvement plans.
Influence technical direction and organizational change across teams without relying solely on direct authority.
Establish feedback loops and measurement frameworks that support continuous improvement.

Advance Engineering Productivity and AI Readiness

Evaluate opportunities to improve developer productivity through automation, tooling, process simplification, and modern engineering practices.
Partner with technology leaders to advance responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering solutions.
Help define approaches for validation, governance, and quality control of AI-enabled workflows.
Assess emerging technologies and practices that improve software delivery effectiveness, reliability, and engineering efficiency.
Promote a culture of experimentation, learning, and continuous modernization.

Measure and Communicate Impact

Define and monitor engineering health, reliability, quality, operational, and productivity indicators.
Create transparency into delivery outcomes, software health trends, remediation effectiveness, and organizational progress.
Use data to identify opportunities, prioritize investments, and guide decision-making.
Communicate recommendations, progress, risks, and outcomes to technical and executive stakeholders.
Demonstrate measurable business value through improved engineering effectiveness and reduced operational friction.

Priority will be given to Candidate who reside in the Columbus, OH metropolitan area.

We are unable to provide sponsorship for this role presently or in the future.

Minimum Qualifications

Degree or equivalent experience. Typically requires 9+ years of professional experience and 1+ years of supervisory and/or management experience.

Critical Skills

8+ years of software engineering experience.
3+ years of engineering leadership experience, including direct people-management responsibilities.
Experience leading software reliability, software quality, platform engineering, modernization, DevSecOps, operational engineering, or engineering productivity initiatives.
Experience partnering with Product Engineering, Cybersecurity, Platform Engineering, and Operations organizations.
Strong knowledge of modern software development lifecycle practices, DevOps principles, and software delivery methodologies.
Experience establishing engineering processes, operating models, standards, or governance frameworks.
Experience using engineering and operational metrics to drive decisions and measure outcomes.
Experience leading cross-functional initiatives within complex, matrixed organizations.
Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to influence teams and leaders across organizational boundaries.

Preferred

Experience with vulnerability remediation, application security, dependency management, or secure software development practices.
Experience with software quality engineering, site reliability engineering, observability, or application support functions.
Experience leading engineering teams supporting multiple products, platforms, or business domains.
Experience working with cloud-native platforms and distributed systems.
Experience partnering with cybersecurity, compliance, risk, or software governance programs.
Experience implementing automation and AI-assisted engineering practices.
Experience improving deployment, testing, release management, validation, or developer productivity workflows.
Experience working within regulated industries and complex enterprise environments.

Success in the First Year

Build trusted relationships with Product Engineering, Platform Engineering, Cybersecurity, and Operations leaders.
Establish a high-performing engineering organization focused on software reliability, operational excellence, and vulnerability remediation.
Implement scalable processes for prioritizing, managing, and tracking remediation work.
Deliver measurable improvements in software quality, engineering productivity, and operational effectiveness.
Improve visibility into software health metrics, remediation progress, and engineering outcomes.
Reduce recurring engineering friction and operational toil through standardization, automation, and process improvements.
Create repeatable capabilities that can scale across multiple products and teams.
Develop a roadmap for expanding the organizational impact of the Operational Engineering function.
Demonstrate measurable business value through improved delivery effectiveness, enhanced software health, and reduced engineering risk.
